blindWork: C4H10 + 13/2 O2 -> 4 CO2 + 5 H2O. n(butane) = 5.60 g / 58.12 g/mol = 0.0964 mol, so n(O2) = 0.626 mol and V = 0.626 × 22.4 L = 14.0 L. The listed value 13.4 L is the only choice near this result (the others are ~12-150% away).
